title: The junk roof job and leading with Ray Teal
summary: DeDroit recalls getting Ray Teal to lead a band at the junk roof while he played trombone, and Teal's later movie career.

I had just proved my way. Of course, I had a couple of people who, who liked me and they flogged me. And I did the same. I, I put Russ Papaya in business and gave him music. No, they didn't want it. That's all. That's terrible. Well, that's the way Ray Teal, he liked violence. You see, I had been leaving the orchestra to jump. They opened the roof. Which roof? The junk roof. The junk roof.

And they wanted an attraction. And I didn't want to lose the job because the job is a job. And I'm talking about the things that are tough. And I was a leader, getting a leader. So I said, well I changed the band. People are like this and they're like me. I said, I'll get you a leader, Ray Teal. I said, he's been at the sangha, he's been a master summer, he plays saxophone. And I was like, I'm a master of the band. And I said, well get him. So I got Ray Teal, we were good friends, we used to make out for a month. So he led the band. But he only wanted one trumpet. He didn't care for brass. But he had three violins, and it was all I played with. And four saxes, piano, bass violin, and I played trombone. And I was the only brass. And it wasn't so easy. I was a good trumpet player, but you see when you're only by yourself, everything you do sticks up.

And he liked a lot of vibrato. And he liked too much vibrato. And I played with vibrato, you've got to do it to have feeling. You know that. You're a tromboneist, you use it yourself, don't you? Yeah, sure. Sure. But because I was the contractor, it's you, you know, if you say I think, I just tell him to shut up, when are we going to play golf tomorrow, or something like that. I didn't take any orders from him. He didn't have any music. He came down here with a coat on and a talisman. I put him on his, well that's all right, he's rich and I went to pictures, you know, he's a movie actor. So they used him in westerns, and he was a sheriff, like the cowardly sheriff in the westerns, and he didn't pay money. But he was a saxophonist.
